data.title: Weekly Workout Plan
data.content:
# Weekly Workout Plan

day: monday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of jumping jacks
- Barbell squats - 4 sets of 8 reps
- Bench press - 4 sets of 6 reps
- Bent-over rows - 3 sets of 10 reps
- Plank - Hold for 1 minute
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of flexibility exercises
duration_mins: 35

day: tuesday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 10 minutes of brisk walking
- Cycling - 45 minutes at a moderate pace
- Bodyweight lunges - 3 sets of 12 reps per leg
- Side planks - Hold for 30 seconds each side
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 65

day: wednesday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of light jogging
- 'Interval training: 10 sets of 1-minute sprint followed by 1.5 minutes of recovery'
- Chin-ups - 3 sets of 6 reps
- Tricep dips - 3 sets of 10 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of deep breathing and stretching
duration_mins: 45

day: thursday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of jump rope
- Deadlifts - 4 sets of 5 reps
- Overhead shoulder press - 3 sets of 8 reps
- Russian twists - 3 sets of 20 reps
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of yoga poses
duration_mins: 30

day: friday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 10 minutes of light cardio
- Swimming - 30 minutes of continuous laps
- Pull-ups - 3 sets of 5 reps
- Leg curls - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 55

day: saturday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of dynamic stretches
- Hiking - 2 hours of moderate-paced hiking in nature
- Cooldown - 5 minutes of deep stretching and mindful breathing
duration_mins: 130

day: sunday
exercises:
- Rest day
duration_mins: 0

data.title: Weekly Workout Plan
data.content:
# Weekly Workout Plan

day: monday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of jumping jacks
- Barbell squats - 4 sets of 8 reps
- Bench press - 4 sets of 6 reps
- Bent-over rows - 3 sets of 10 reps
- Plank - Hold for 1 minute
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of flexibility exercises
duration_mins: 35

day: tuesday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 10 minutes of brisk walking
- Cycling - 45 minutes at a moderate pace
- Bodyweight lunges - 3 sets of 12 reps per leg
- Side planks - Hold for 30 seconds each side
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 65

day: wednesday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of light jogging
- 'Interval training: 10 sets of 1-minute sprint followed by 1.5 minutes of recovery'
- Chin-ups - 3 sets of 6 reps
- Tricep dips - 3 sets of 10 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of deep breathing and stretching
duration_mins: 45

day: thursday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of jump rope
- Deadlifts - 4 sets of 5 reps
- Overhead shoulder press - 3 sets of 8 reps
- Russian twists - 3 sets of 20 reps
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of yoga poses
duration_mins: 30

day: friday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 10 minutes of light cardio
- Swimming - 30 minutes of continuous laps
- Pull-ups - 3 sets of 5 reps
- Leg curls - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 55

day: saturday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of dynamic stretches
- Hiking - 2 hours of moderate-paced hiking in nature
- Cooldown - 5 minutes of deep stretching and mindful breathing
duration_mins: 130

day: sunday
exercises:
- Rest day
duration_mins: 0

data.title: Weekly Workout Plan
data.content:
# Weekly Workout Plan

day: monday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of jumping jacks
- Barbell squats - 4 sets of 8 reps
- Bench press - 4 sets of 6 reps
- Bent-over rows - 3 sets of 10 reps
- Plank - Hold for 1 minute
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of flexibility exercises
duration_mins: 35

day: tuesday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 10 minutes of brisk walking
- Cycling - 45 minutes at a moderate pace
- Bodyweight lunges - 3 sets of 12 reps per leg
- Side planks - Hold for 30 seconds each side
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 65

day: wednesday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of light jogging
- 'Interval training: 10 sets of 1-minute sprint followed by 1.5 minutes of recovery'
- Chin-ups - 3 sets of 6 reps
- Tricep dips - 3 sets of 10 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of deep breathing and stretching
duration_mins: 45

day: thursday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of jump rope
- Deadlifts - 4 sets of 5 reps
- Overhead shoulder press - 3 sets of 8 reps
- Russian twists - 3 sets of 20 reps
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of yoga poses
duration_mins: 30

day: friday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 10 minutes of light cardio
- Swimming - 30 minutes of continuous laps
- Pull-ups - 3 sets of 5 reps
- Leg curls - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 55

day: saturday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of dynamic stretches
- Hiking - 2 hours of moderate-paced hiking in nature
- Cooldown - 5 minutes of deep stretching and mindful breathing
duration_mins: 130

day: sunday
exercises:
- Rest day
duration_mins: 0

# Weekly Workout Plan

day: monday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of jumping jacks
- Barbell squats - 4 sets of 8 reps
- Bench press - 4 sets of 6 reps
- Bent-over rows - 3 sets of 10 reps
- Plank - Hold for 1 minute
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of flexibility exercises
duration_mins: 35

day: tuesday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 10 minutes of brisk walking
- Cycling - 45 minutes at a moderate pace
- Bodyweight lunges - 3 sets of 12 reps per leg
- Side planks - Hold for 30 seconds each side
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 65

day: wednesday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of light jogging
- 'Interval training: 10 sets of 1-minute sprint followed by 1.5 minutes of recovery'
- Chin-ups - 3 sets of 6 reps
- Tricep dips - 3 sets of 10 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of deep breathing and stretching
duration_mins: 45

day: thursday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of jump rope
- Deadlifts - 4 sets of 5 reps
- Overhead shoulder press - 3 sets of 8 reps
- Russian twists - 3 sets of 20 reps
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of yoga poses
duration_mins: 30

day: friday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 10 minutes of light cardio
- Swimming - 30 minutes of continuous laps
- Pull-ups - 3 sets of 5 reps
- Leg curls - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 55

day: saturday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of dynamic stretches
- Hiking - 2 hours of moderate-paced hiking in nature
- Cooldown - 5 minutes of deep stretching and mindful breathing
duration_mins: 130

day: sunday
exercises:
- Rest day
duration_mins: 0

- Russian twists - 3 sets of 20 reps

data.title: Weekly Workout Plan
data.content:
# Weekly Workout Plan

day: monday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of jumping jacks
- Barbell squats - 4 sets of 8 reps
- Bench press - 4 sets of 6 reps
- Bent-over rows - 3 sets of 10 reps
- Plank - Hold for 1 minute
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of flexibility exercises
duration_mins: 35

day: tuesday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 10 minutes of brisk walking
- Cycling - 45 minutes at a moderate pace
- Bodyweight lunges - 3 sets of 12 reps per leg
- Side planks - Hold for 30 seconds each side
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 65

day: wednesday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of light jogging
- 'Interval training: 10 sets of 1-minute sprint followed by 1.5 minutes of recovery'
- Chin-ups - 3 sets of 6 reps
- Tricep dips - 3 sets of 10 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of deep breathing and stretching
duration_mins: 45

day: thursday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of jump rope
- Deadlifts - 4 sets of 5 reps
- Overhead shoulder press - 3 sets of 8 reps
- Russian twists - 3 sets of 20 reps
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of yoga poses
duration_mins: 30

day: friday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 10 minutes of light cardio
- Swimming - 30 minutes of continuous laps
- Pull-ups - 3 sets of 5 reps
- Leg curls - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 55

day: saturday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of dynamic stretches
- Hiking - 2 hours of moderate-paced hiking in nature
- Cooldown - 5 minutes of deep stretching and mindful breathing
duration_mins: 130

day: sunday
exercises:
- Rest day
duration_mins: 0

day: monday
exercises:

- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches

- 'Interval training: 10 sets of 1-minute sprint followed by 1.5 minutes of recovery'

data.title: Weekly Workout Plan
data.content:
# Weekly Workout Plan

day: monday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of jumping jacks
- Barbell squats - 4 sets of 8 reps
- Bench press - 4 sets of 6 reps
- Bent-over rows - 3 sets of 10 reps
- Plank - Hold for 1 minute
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of flexibility exercises
duration_mins: 35

day: tuesday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 10 minutes of brisk walking
- Cycling - 45 minutes at a moderate pace
- Bodyweight lunges - 3 sets of 12 reps per leg
- Side planks - Hold for 30 seconds each side
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 65

day: wednesday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of light jogging
- 'Interval training: 10 sets of 1-minute sprint followed by 1.5 minutes of recovery'
- Chin-ups - 3 sets of 6 reps
- Tricep dips - 3 sets of 10 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of deep breathing and stretching
duration_mins: 45

day: thursday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of jump rope
- Deadlifts - 4 sets of 5 reps
- Overhead shoulder press - 3 sets of 8 reps
- Russian twists - 3 sets of 20 reps
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of yoga poses
duration_mins: 30

day: friday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 10 minutes of light cardio
- Swimming - 30 minutes of continuous laps
- Pull-ups - 3 sets of 5 reps
- Leg curls - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 55

day: saturday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of dynamic stretches
- Hiking - 2 hours of moderate-paced hiking in nature
- Cooldown - 5 minutes of deep stretching and mindful breathing
duration_mins: 130

day: sunday
exercises:
- Rest day
duration_mins: 0

data.title: Weekly Workout Plan
data.content:
# Weekly Workout Plan

day: monday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of jumping jacks
- Barbell squats - 4 sets of 8 reps
- Bench press - 4 sets of 6 reps
- Bent-over rows - 3 sets of 10 reps
- Plank - Hold for 1 minute
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of flexibility exercises
duration_mins: 35

day: tuesday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 10 minutes of brisk walking
- Cycling - 45 minutes at a moderate pace
- Bodyweight lunges - 3 sets of 12 reps per leg
- Side planks - Hold for 30 seconds each side
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 65

day: wednesday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of light jogging
- 'Interval training: 10 sets of 1-minute sprint followed by 1.5 minutes of recovery'
- Chin-ups - 3 sets of 6 reps
- Tricep dips - 3 sets of 10 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of deep breathing and stretching
duration_mins: 45

day: thursday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of jump rope
- Deadlifts - 4 sets of 5 reps
- Overhead shoulder press - 3 sets of 8 reps
- Russian twists - 3 sets of 20 reps
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of yoga poses
duration_mins: 30

day: friday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 10 minutes of light cardio
- Swimming - 30 minutes of continuous laps
- Pull-ups - 3 sets of 5 reps
- Leg curls - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 55

day: saturday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of dynamic stretches
- Hiking - 2 hours of moderate-paced hiking in nature
- Cooldown - 5 minutes of deep stretching and mindful breathing
duration_mins: 130

day: sunday
exercises:
- Rest day
duration_mins: 0

data.title: Weekly Workout Plan
data.content:
# Weekly Workout Plan

day: monday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of jumping jacks
- Barbell squats - 4 sets of 8 reps
- Bench press - 4 sets of 6 reps
- Bent-over rows - 3 sets of 10 reps
- Plank - Hold for 1 minute
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of flexibility exercises
duration_mins: 35

day: tuesday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 10 minutes of brisk walking
- Cycling - 45 minutes at a moderate pace
- Bodyweight lunges - 3 sets of 12 reps per leg
- Side planks - Hold for 30 seconds each side
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 65

day: wednesday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of light jogging
- 'Interval training: 10 sets of 1-minute sprint followed by 1.5 minutes of recovery'
- Chin-ups - 3 sets of 6 reps
- Tricep dips - 3 sets of 10 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of deep breathing and stretching
duration_mins: 45

day: thursday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of jump rope
- Deadlifts - 4 sets of 5 reps
- Overhead shoulder press - 3 sets of 8 reps
- Russian twists - 3 sets of 20 reps
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of yoga poses
duration_mins: 30

day: friday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 10 minutes of light cardio
- Swimming - 30 minutes of continuous laps
- Pull-ups - 3 sets of 5 reps
- Leg curls - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 55

day: saturday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of dynamic stretches
- Hiking - 2 hours of moderate-paced hiking in nature
- Cooldown - 5 minutes of deep stretching and mindful breathing
duration_mins: 130

day: sunday
exercises:
- Rest day
duration_mins: 0

data.content:
# Weekly Workout Plan

day: monday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of jumping jacks
- Barbell squats - 4 sets of 8 reps
- Bench press - 4 sets of 6 reps
- Bent-over rows - 3 sets of 10 reps
- Plank - Hold for 1 minute
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of flexibility exercises
duration_mins: 35

day: tuesday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 10 minutes of brisk walking
- Cycling - 45 minutes at a moderate pace
- Bodyweight lunges - 3 sets of 12 reps per leg
- Side planks - Hold for 30 seconds each side
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 65

day: wednesday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of light jogging
- 'Interval training: 10 sets of 1-minute sprint followed by 1.5 minutes of recovery'
- Chin-ups - 3 sets of 6 reps
- Tricep dips - 3 sets of 10 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of deep breathing and stretching
duration_mins: 45

day: thursday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of jump rope
- Deadlifts - 4 sets of 5 reps
- Overhead shoulder press - 3 sets of 8 reps
- Russian twists - 3 sets of 20 reps
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of yoga poses
duration_mins: 30

day: friday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 10 minutes of light cardio
- Swimming - 30 minutes of continuous laps
- Pull-ups - 3 sets of 5 reps
- Leg curls - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 55

day: saturday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of dynamic stretches
- Hiking - 2 hours of moderate-paced hiking in nature
- Cooldown - 5 minutes of deep stretching and mindful breathing
duration_mins: 130

day: sunday
exercises:
- Rest day
duration_mins: 0

data.title: Weekly Workout Plan
data.content:
# Weekly Workout Plan

day: monday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of jumping jacks
- Barbell squats - 4 sets of 8 reps
- Bench press - 4 sets of 6 reps
- Bent-over rows - 3 sets of 10 reps
- Plank - Hold for 1 minute
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of flexibility exercises
duration_mins: 35

day: tuesday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 10 minutes of brisk walking
- Cycling - 45 minutes at a moderate pace
- Bodyweight lunges - 3 sets of 12 reps per leg
- Side planks - Hold for 30 seconds each side
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 65

day: wednesday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of light jogging
- 'Interval training: 10 sets of 1-minute sprint followed by 1.5 minutes of recovery'
- Chin-ups - 3 sets of 6 reps
- Tricep dips - 3 sets of 10 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of deep breathing and stretching
duration_mins: 45

day: thursday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of jump rope
- Deadlifts - 4 sets of 5 reps
- Overhead shoulder press - 3 sets of 8 reps
- Russian twists - 3 sets of 20 reps
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of yoga poses
duration_mins: 30

day: friday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 10 minutes of light cardio
- Swimming - 30 minutes of continuous laps
- Pull-ups - 3 sets of 5 reps
- Leg curls - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 55

day: saturday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of dynamic stretches
- Hiking - 2 hours of moderate-paced hiking in nature
- Cooldown - 5 minutes of deep stretching and mindful breathing
duration_mins: 130

day: sunday
exercises:
- Rest day

data.title: Weekly Workout Plan
data.content:
# Weekly Workout Plan

day: monday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of jumping jacks
- Barbell squats - 4 sets of 8 reps
- Bench press - 4 sets of 6 reps
- Bent-over rows - 3 sets of 10 reps
- Plank - Hold for 1 minute
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of flexibility exercises
duration_mins: 35

day: tuesday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 10 minutes of brisk walking
- Cycling - 45 minutes at a moderate pace
- Bodyweight lunges - 3 sets of 12 reps per leg
- Side planks - Hold for 30 seconds each side
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 65

day: wednesday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of light jogging
- 'Interval training: 10 sets of 1-minute sprint followed by 1.5 minutes of recovery'
- Chin-ups - 3 sets of 6 reps
- Tricep dips - 3 sets of 10 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of deep breathing and stretching
duration_mins: 45

day: thursday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of jump rope
- Deadlifts - 4 sets of 5 reps
- Overhead shoulder press - 3 sets of 8 reps
- Russian twists - 3 sets of 20 reps
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of yoga poses
duration_mins: 30

day: friday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 10 minutes of light cardio
- Swimming - 30 minutes of continuous laps
- Pull-ups - 3 sets of 5 reps
- Leg curls - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 55

day: saturday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of dynamic stretches
- Hiking - 2 hours of moderate-paced hiking in nature
- Cooldown - 5 minutes of deep stretching and mindful breathing
duration_mins: 130

day: sunday
exercises:
- Rest day
duration_mins: 0

data.title: Weekly Workout Plan
data.content:
# Weekly Workout Plan

day: monday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of jumping jacks
- Barbell squats - 4 sets of 8 reps
- Bench press - 4 sets of 6 reps
- Bent-over rows - 3 sets of 10 reps
- Plank - Hold for 1 minute
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of flexibility exercises
duration_mins: 35

day: tuesday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 10 minutes of brisk walking
- Cycling - 45 minutes at a moderate pace
- Bodyweight lunges - 3 sets of 12 reps per leg
- Side planks - Hold for 30 seconds each side
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 65

day: wednesday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of light jogging
- 'Interval training: 10 sets of 1-minute sprint followed by 1.5 minutes of recovery'
- Chin-ups - 3 sets of 6 reps
- Tricep dips - 3 sets of 10 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of deep breathing and stretching
duration_mins: 45

day: thursday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of jump rope
- Deadlifts - 4 sets of 5 reps
- Overhead shoulder press - 3 sets of 8 reps
- Russian twists - 3 sets of 20 reps
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of yoga poses
duration_mins: 30

day: friday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 10 minutes of light cardio
- Swimming - 30 minutes of continuous laps
- Pull-ups - 3 sets of 5 reps
- Leg curls - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 55

day: saturday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of dynamic stretches
- Hiking - 2 hours of moderate-paced hiking in nature
- Cooldown - 5 minutes of deep stretching and mindful breathing
duration_mins: 130

day: sunday
exercises:
- Rest day
duration_mins: 0

data.title: Weekly Workout Plan
data.content:
# Weekly Workout Plan

day: monday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of jumping jacks
- Barbell squats - 4 sets of 8 reps
- Bench press - 4 sets of 6 reps
- Bent-over rows - 3 sets of 10 reps
- Plank - Hold for 1 minute
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of flexibility exercises
duration_mins: 35

day: tuesday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 10 minutes of brisk walking
- Cycling - 45 minutes at a moderate pace
- Bodyweight lunges - 3 sets of 12 reps per leg
- Side planks - Hold for 30 seconds each side
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 65

day: wednesday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of light jogging
- 'Interval training: 10 sets of 1-minute sprint followed by 1.5 minutes of recovery'
- Chin-ups - 3 sets of 6 reps
- Tricep dips - 3 sets of 10 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of deep breathing and stretching
duration_mins: 45

day: thursday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of jump rope
- Deadlifts - 4 sets of 5 reps
- Overhead shoulder press - 3 sets of 8 reps
- Russian twists - 3 sets of 20 reps
- Cool-down - 10 minutes of yoga poses
duration_mins: 30

day: friday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 10 minutes of light cardio
- Swimming - 30 minutes of continuous laps
- Pull-ups - 3 sets of 5 reps
- Leg curls - 3 sets of 12 reps
- Cool-down - 5 minutes of gentle stretches
duration_mins: 55

day: saturday
exercises:
- Warm-up - 5 minutes of dynamic stretches
- Hiking - 2 hours of moderate-paced hiking in nature
- Cooldown - 5 minutes of deep stretching and mindful breathing
duration_mins: 130

day: sunday
exercises:
- Rest day
duration_mins: 0
